sections.summary: The neutral reading finds this section explains Paul's imprisonment on behalf of the Gentiles and the content of the mystery revealed to him: that the Gentiles are co-heirs, co-members of the body, and co-sharers of the promise in Christ Jesus through the gospel, with three syn-compounds emphasizing full and equal partnership.

sections.section_title: Paul's Commission and Its Cosmic Scope
sections.summary: The neutral reading finds this section describes Paul's apostolic commission to preach the unsearchable riches of Christ to the Gentiles and to illuminate the mystery hidden for ages, so that through the church God's manifold wisdom would be made known to cosmic rulers and authorities in the heavenly places, according to God's eternal purpose carried out in Christ.

sections.section_title: The Prayer for Inner Strengthening and Comprehension
sections.summary: The neutral reading finds this section contains Paul's prayer that the recipients would be strengthened by the Spirit in the inner person, that Christ would dwell permanently in their hearts through faith, that they would comprehend the immeasurable dimensions of Christ's love together with all the saints, and that they would be filled to all the fullness of God.

The neutral reading finds this section is a doxology declaring that God is able to do far more abundantly than all that is asked or thought, according to the power at work in the community, ascribing glory to God in the church and in Christ Jesus throughout all generations forever.
